annotation.description:
the video shows a city in winder, where a small downhill slope full of snow was erected with hay to the side of it.
3 lanes are constructed, whiere the video is focused on the rightmost lane.
A girl with a red sleigh can be seen, as she is pushed by a man in a white t shirt, causing her to go downhill.
A man in beige pants and a blue jacket holding a shovel is blocking the view.
in the background, red and green flags are waving in the wind
